data.long_meaning: Derived from Margaret, meaning 'pearl' in Greek, which symbolizes great value and rarity. In Christianity, it is a name associated with the Virgin Mary. The name Margaretta carries the meaning “Mary's Pearl” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Margaretta usually hope their child will grow to embody mary's pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name holds deeper spiritual dimensions. The name Margaretta, derived from Margaret, the Latin form of Miriam, evokes images of the Virgin Mary – a model of faith, purity, and devotion. Additionally, the name is associated with the pearl of great price, a metaphor in the New Testament for the inestimable value of salvation (Matthew 13:45-46). Thus, this ancient name embraces the earthly beauty of a pearl, the virtuous character of Saint Margaret, and the spiritual treasures of Christian faith.
